errors.evidence: The description uses the subjective phrase 'варират значително' (vary significantly) to describe the range of data values, which is an interpretation of the magnitude of the variation rather than an objective statement.
The description misspells the category label 'афилиация' as 'афилизация'. The correct label in the chart is 'афилиация (институционална принадлежност на автора/ume)'.
